nusmp.page.book_slash.lunatic_slash: Death Scythe: Lunatic Slash - the forearm blades throw a chaotic flurry of ten flying slashes in one second over an 80 degree cone: each pierces for 6 x EP scale and cuts adaptively. Uses aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.adaptive_edge: Adaptive Edge - the blades read the foe you look at: three adaptation marks are laid on it at once, the barriers around it are cut down, and its magic is jammed for 4 s (2 s and half as likely on a boss).
nusmp.page.book_slash.forearm_blades: Forearm Blades - the Ripper's armour forges on you for 20 seconds, a long green-edged blade along each forearm; every melee blow cuts harder and adapts. Held with aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.ripper_dash: Ripper Dash - a burst of speed that carries you 10 blocks through your foes, cutting each one and leaving glass afterimages along the path. Uses aura.
